s.t: Alice Costelloe chose the song’s closing affirmation deliberately, inspired by a quote from Feist about repetition becoming a kind of spell.
s.q: its closing affirmation was a deliberate choice. Inspired by a quote from Feist about repetition becoming a kind of spell

s.t: Alice Costelloe wrote ‘How Can I’ to counterbalance the heavier moments on her debut album, admitting she knows it is “unbearably cheesy”.
s.q: I know it's unbearably cheesy, but I wanted a moment that could manifest something more positive.

s.t: ‘How Can I’ was the last preview released before Alice Costelloe’s debut album Move On With The Year came out on Moshi Moshi Records on 6 February 2026.
s.q: The track is the final preview of the album. It is out 6 February via Moshi Moshi Records.

s.t: Alice Costelloe’s album Move On With The Year, which includes ‘How Can I’, was produced by Mike Lindsay in his Margate studio, with mellotron drones and fluttering flutes.
s.q: Produced by Mike Lindsay (Laura Marling, Anna B Savage, LUMP) in his Margate studio ... a world of mellotron drones, fluttering flutes, warped synths and stumbling pianos
